opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions in the UK undertaking internationally competitive research. University Development Office should coordinate applications.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process, two rounds per year.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Grants to special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, supporting projects that help pupils at secondary level develop skills for employment or independent living. New build, refurbishment and equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for places providing excellent care to patients and their families in hospices and palliative care organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charities (or equivalent) and local authorities. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Grants to capital projects which help people with disabilities live more independently, particularly projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing, especially helping young people transition from children's to adults' services.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on projects focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or a local authority. If applicable, should have at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations which provide care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections, fully accredited and open to the public.
opportunities.summary: Grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections with a clear emphasis on public access and engagement.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating museums and galleries holding permanent collections of national significance, fully accredited.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with performing arts constituting the vast majority of its activities.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishment of these facilities and occasionally related specialist equipment.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited if applicable.
opportunities.summary: Grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces.

opportunities.title: Funding for secondary schools & sixth form colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Maximum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £50,000 (equipment), £15,000 – £100,000 (new build and refurbishment)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: State-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges with at least two years of exam results, inspected by Ofsted/Estyn/HMIE/ETI with an overall 'Good' or above rating.
opportunities.summary: Grants towards capital projects that help high-achieving state-funded secondary schools and sixth form colleges create and improve specialist spaces and equipment for teaching GCSE and A-Level subjects. 2026 round closed; next round expected spring 2027.
